focus: Cost and accuracy levers: redundant third call, tiebreak bias, threshold calibration

title: Early stop after agreeing AB+BA removes 58 of 181 calls (-32%) with identical decisions, counts and verdict.
The AB-repeat tiebreak decided both recorded 1-1 splits against the label; a symmetric rule scores A=55 instead of 53.
SAME_AT 0.4 scores 57/60 versus 53/60 at 0.5; specificity is unchanged across 0.35-0.5.
Calibration bins under 0.3 are 0% same and 0.4-0.6 is 7/7 same; the three false-merges at 0.59-0.93 are cut-insensitive model errors.
Judgment calls run at mean 323 ms against a 90 s timeout and about 65 input tokens each; early stop cuts both by roughly a third.
Zero-call Jaccard 0.4 and containment 0.6 over the same text both score 53/60, tying the shipped model column on the labeled set.
Mean BA minus AB is +0.029 with median absolute delta 0.04; a symmetric two-order aggregate keeps noise averaging without the position tilt.

direction: More calls per pair raise accuracy
reason: 57 of 60 pairs were unanimous after two calls; the third changed no correct answer and caused two misses
